A only checks filename and tests generic bytes.Reader retry separately."],"risks_a":["Upload duplicates Add’s option, request, decoding, and error logic instead of calling Add, violating the required repository pattern.","Tests do not verify uploaded content, Upload retry behavior, validation, source-reader errors, or option propagation."],"risks_b":["Changes established Add behavior by eagerly consuming and buffering arbitrary caller-provided multipart bodies.","Changes Add source-reader error timing and wraps errors with new text, potentially affecting callers.","Upload calls a new private add helper rather than the required existing Add method, and the added machinery creates unnecessary contract-driven churn around Add itself—but tests don't include the contract-required validation and source-reader-error cases."]}
